hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *TEMP.md ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"TEMP.md is the user scratchpad and is protected by a project hook. Never edit it without an explicit user request; if the user truly wants this, they must temporarily disable the hook in .claude/settings.json."}}'; fi; }

if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'TEMP.md'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"TEMP.md is staged. Unstage it before committing: git restore --staged TEMP.md. TEMP.md is the user scratchpad and should never be committed by Claude."}}'; fi
